items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I think you went with Henry Horne and Joe after you left there.

ctx.x: No, I think you went with Henry Horne and Joe after you left there. You didn't... You went with Henry Horne after, because I used to come up there sometime. I was going to ask you about Joe Turner too, since he's a well known blues singer.
If you remember which records you made with him and what label?
